# Sourcebae

> AI-powered staffing platform that connects businesses with pre-vetted developers, data experts, and AI trainers through intelligent recruitment automation.

Sourcebae is an AI-driven recruitment platform that specializes in matching companies with vetted tech talent across 180+ tech stacks. The platform serves startups, scale-ups, and enterprises with hiring solutions including RPO, MSP, and Global Capability Center services, with operations in India and a focus on remote and contract hiring.

## Key Topics

- AI recruitment
- Pre-vetted talent
- Developer hiring
- Recruitment automation
- Talent acquisition
- Hiring platform
- RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing)
- MSP (Managed Service Provider)
- Global Capability Centers
- AI trainers
- LLM training
- Remote work
- Contract staffing
- Talent advisory

## Hiring Solutions

- [Access Pre-Vetted Developers in 24 Hours](https://sourcebae.com/access-of-top-developers): Access AI-vetted developer shortlists within 24 hours.
- [Hire Pre-Vetted Top Developers](https://sourcebae.com/hire/hire-developers): Hire pre-vetted developers across 180+ tech stacks with AI vetting.
- [Hire AI Trainers & Data Experts](https://sourcebae.com/hire-human-data-experts): Hire AI trainers and data experts for LLM fine-tuning and model training.
- [Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO)](https://sourcebae.com/rpo): RPO service with AI interviews, global talent, and full-cycle support.
- [Managed Service Provider (MSP)](https://sourcebae.com/msp): MSP service for tech and non-tech hiring with vendor management.
- [Global Capability Center (GCC) Services](https://sourcebae.com/gcc): Build and scale Global Capability Centers in India with AI hiring.
